headline: Approved previous meeting minutes; discussed the Hamden Through Time exhibit and new event ideas.
summary: Members approved the minutes from the August 12 meeting. They reviewed account balances and July concert donations and expenses, and discussed the Hamden Through Time project. They also gave input on new project ideas, including a roller skating event.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the August 12, 2026 meeting. The motion passed with approval from all voting members.

decision_evidence.quote: Marita Gargiulo made a motion to approve the minutes from 8.12.26. Rodney West seconded the motion. Motion was approved by all voting members.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
ARTS COMMISSION 
AND 
LEGISLATIVE COUNCIL  
COMMITTEE OF THE WHOLE 
MEETING MINUTES 
 
September 2, 2026 
 
7:00pm 
 
Hamden Government Center 
Third Floor Conference Room 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
 
 
  
1. CALL TO ORDER   
 Commission Chair Doc Martin called the meeting to order at 7:12pm. 
2. ATTENDANCE   
 In Person: Doc Martin, Rodney West, Chloe Fang, Donna Elking, Peggy Craft 
Online: Ryan Brown, Nikilia Ried, Marita Gargiulo, Charles Kortsep 
3. PUBLIC COMMENT   
 No public comment. 
4. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES   
 
 
  1. August 12th, 2026  
  Marita Gargiulo made a motion to approve the minutes from 8.12.26. Rodney West 
seconded the motion. Motion was approved by all voting members. 
5. CORRESPONDENCE 
There will be a brief summary of the correspondence submitted between the last 
correspondence update and this one. This includes but is not limited to any 
correspondence with council members that members wish to submit for the record. It can 
also include written communication to the council from the administration, community 
members, etc.   
 Commission Chair Doc Martin discussed the meeting with the town clerk regarding the 
Hamden Through Time project. 
6. REPORTS   
 The Commission briefly discussed the Webster and Bankwell accounts: 
• The Commission and no one on the Commission has made any expenditures 
utilizing either accounts
• Charles Kortsep reviewed the last known balance of the Commission's accounts: 
o Gift Fund: $42,902.80 as of 12.31.2025 
o Saturday Series: $6,382.27 
o Sunday Series/Peter Harrold: $68,000-$69,000 
o Bankwell: unknown 
 
Doc reviewed the donations made from the Summer Concert Series and expenditures for 
the hospitality lounge: 
• July 10th 
o Donations: $170 
o Expenditures:$188.63 
• July 17th 
o Donations: $178 
o Expenditures: $140.99 
• July 24th 
o Donations: $114.75 
o Expenditures:$99.30 
• July 30th 
o Donations: $200.09 
o Expenditures: $153.75 
•  
 
7. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 
 
8. OLD BUSINESS   
 
 
9. NEW BUSINESS   
 
 
  1. Discussion on the Hamden Through Time project and exhibit. 
 
   
  Doc discussed Hamden Through Time: 
• The goal is to tell one community story across three months with residents and 
partners creating the content. 
o September 
▪ The Commission is tasked with creating visual presentations of 
famous people from Hamden. 
▪ Chloe Fang discussed creating a painting of Jennifer Barnhart 
who play Zoe on Seasame Street. 
o October 
▪ How Hamden got its name 
▪ How Hamden got its Mascot
▪ Major Weather Events 
▪ Former Businesses 
▪ Hamden Plaza 
▪ Sunken Cars 
o November 
▪ Talk about culture 
▪ Identify arts & arts organizations that the commission can bring 
to the event at the Eli Whitney  
o December 
▪ Hamden's future 
▪ Looking for kids to come up with drawings, artwork and models 
talking about the future 
 
  2. Discussion on new projects and fundraisers for the remainder of the year and 
beginning of next year.  
  Rodney West presented several ideas for projects: 
• Origami Paper Crafts 
• Snowman Contest 
• Nature Collage & Recycled Art Workshop 
• Youth Art Market 
• Chalk Fest 
• Community Painting Picnic 
• Student Gallery & Community Collaborative Mural 
 
The Commission provided feedback and gave input on the presented ideas. 
 
Nikilia Ried discussed her idea for a roller skating event. 
  
10. ADJOURNMENT   
 Peggy Craft made a motion to adjourn the meeting. Donna Elking seconded. Meeting 
adjourned at 7:13pm.

1. CALL TO ORDER   
 Commission Chair Doc Martin called the meeting to order at 7:52PM. 
2. ATTENDANCE   
 In Person: Doc Martin 
Online: Charles Kortsep, Donna Elkin, Ryan Brown, Nikila Reid, Quinn Wainwright, Marita 
Gargiulo & Chloe Fang 
3. PUBLIC COMMENT   
 No public comment. 
4. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES   
 
 
  1. July 8th, 2026  
  Donna Elkin motioned to approve July 8th's meeting minutes. Marita Gargiulo 
seconded the motion. Motion approved by all voting members.  
5. CORRESPONDENCE 
There will be a brief summary of the correspondence submitted between the last 
correspondence update and this one. This includes but is not limited to any 
correspondence with council members that members wish to submit for the record. It can 
also include written communication to the council from the administration, community 
members, etc.   
 No correspondence. 
6. REPORTS   
 Doc reported on expenses and proceeds through donations in the Summer Concert Series 
recap.  
7. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)
No executive session needed. 
8. OLD BUSINESS   
 
 
  1. Summer Concert Series Wrap up  
  Doc reviewed the pros and cons of the Summer Concert Series as well as proceeds 
made through donations. 
9. NEW BUSINESS   
 
 
  1. Plans for upcoming events for the remainder of the year.  
  The Commission discussed some ideas for future/upcoming events. 
Ryan: 
• Street Chalk 
• Restaurant Week, 
• Food Truck Festival 
Nikila: 
• Skate Event 
• music, donations, etc. 
Doc: 
• Hamden Through Time 
o September 1st - September 19th 
o 240 years of Hamden 
o Town Founders 
o Quinninapiac Native Americans 
o Sleeping Giant Mountain 
o Schools in Hamden 
o Dragon Mascot 
o Recent Tornadoes 
o Sunken Cars 
o Merritt Parkway 
• Poster Boards 
• Movie 
• Famous People in Hamden 
 
10. ADJOURNMENT   
 Donna Elkin made a motion to adjourn the meeting. Nikilia Reid seconded the motion. Meeting 
adjourned at 8:10pm.
